name: Ambrey Rail Freight
description: Rail freight operator moving aggregates and containers across the fictional region of Calderwold.

items.title: Freight services overview
items.content: Ambrey runs 38 trains a week and moves 2.4 million tonnes a year across Calderwold. Overview ARF-DR-0605.

items.title: Terminal opening hours
items.content: The Calderwold Inland Terminal on Siding Road receives containers 05:40 to 22:10, Monday to Saturday. Notice ARF-TRM-1.

items.title: Locomotive fuelling procedure
items.content: Locos are fuelled at road 4 to 92% of tank capacity; spills are reported to Hilde Marsh within 30 minutes on form ARF-FUEL-26.

items.title: Driver roster pattern
items.content: Drivers work a 7-day rotating pattern with a maximum turn of 10 hours 15 minutes; rest days are swapped through the roster clerk. Pattern ARF-RST-07.

items.title: Uniform supply contract
items.content: Hi-vis uniforms are supplied by Brightline Workwear at $86.40 per set, 2 sets per driver a year, until 2027-07-31. Contract ARF-UNI-0731.

items.title: Quarry haulage tender
items.content: Ambrey bid $11.25 per tonne to haul 1.9 million tonnes a year from Hexley Quarry for 7 years; the quarry decides on 2026-12-18. Tender ARF-TND-5518-H.
